title: Legislative districts of Guimaras

{{Short description|Districts of Philippine province}} {{Politics of the Philippines}} The '''legislative districts of Guimaras''' are the representations of the [[Provinces of the Philippines|province]] of [[Guimaras]] in the [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|various national legislatures]] of the [[Philippines]]. The province is currently represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the [[Congress of the Philippines]] through its [[#Lone District|lone congressional district]]. == History == Prior to gaining its separate representation, [[Guimaras]] was a [[sub-provinces of the Philippines|sub-province]] of [[Iloilo]] and was last represented as part of [[Iloilo's 2nd congressional district|Iloilo's 2nd district]] in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] from 1987 to 1995 and in earlier [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|national legislatures]] from 1907 to 1972.{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=4667|url=https://www.lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4667_1966.html |title=An Act Creating the Subprovince of Guimaras in the Province of Iloilo |date=June 18, 1966 |accessdate=December 8, 2022}} It was also formerly included in the multi-member [[Iloilo's at-large congressional district|Iloilo's at-large district]] for the [[Malolos Congress]] from 1898 to 1899 and for the [[Regular Batasang Pambansa]] from 1984 to 1986 and the multi-member [[Western Visayas|Region VI]]'s at-large district for the [[Interim Batasang Pambansa]] from 1978 to 1984.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 13, 2021}} Guimaras was given its own representation ahead of the [[1995 Philippine House of Representatives elections]] following its conversion into a regular province under the 1991 Local Government Code (Republic Act No. 7160) which was ratified in a 1992 plebiscite concurrent with [[1992 Philippine general election|that year's general election]].{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=7160|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1991/10/10/republic-act-no-7160/ |title=An Act Providing for a Local Government Code of 1991|date=October
